prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1353; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and the trunk lid shows a crease along its left edge, with the tail lamp assembly broken on the driver side. The damage pattern matches the rear-end impact as described, and the surrounding panels show no signs of a separate or older event. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and lamp, straightening the trunk lid, and refinishing the affected areas. The estimated labor hours are consistent with this scope of work, and the parts listed correspond to what the visible damage requires. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record, and the invoices reviewed contain no duplicated line items.
